label: LDW-OWNED PROOF / PRECOMPUTED
source: Website Quality Toolkit (WQT) / SiteOne-derived technical evidence
evidenceCycle: Accepted LDW Stage A managed-visibility cycle
freshness: Historical accepted evidence; this page does not refresh or re-run the source
coverage: One accepted technical finding plus one provider-controlled residual limitation; this is not a complete website assessment
claimBoundary: This technical remeasurement does not establish ranking, AI-citation or AI-visibility, traffic, lead, revenue, security, compliance, or overall-site-health impact.

finding.title: Static asset cache finding
finding.summary: Same-source remeasurement observed fewer static-assets-short-cache findings after one bounded LDW-controlled change.
finding.meaning: The accepted source observed a narrower technical finding on recheck. That supports describing the measured technical change only; it does not establish broader search, AI, traffic, lead, revenue, security, or business impact.
finding.action: LDW made one bounded cache-related change through the accepted website change path, then rechecked with the same source.
finding.verification: The accepted Stage A cycle used same-source WQT / SiteOne-derived technical evidence for the before observation and recheck.
finding.recheck: Same-source remeasurement observed 1 remaining static-assets-short-cache finding.

residual.title: Provider-controlled cache behavior remained
residual.summary: A provider-controlled residual cache/noise item remained after the LDW-controlled change. It was deliberately not treated as an LDW-controlled defect or chased merely to make the result look clean.
residual.limitation: Because this residual remains provider-controlled and this proof covers only a bounded technical slice, the page must not represent the website as fully healthy or complete.

notMeasured: AI citation or AI visibility impact
